scope: Exercise extracted WrapFD publication/unwind, permission rollback and empty-load handling.
limitations: Extracted create_wrap/rewrap/protection methods and the empty-load prefix run with allocator, fd reservation, file/inode, DMA-buffer and usercopy shims. RefCell detects destructor relocking as a caught panic instead of hanging on a native mutex. Does not execute native LSM, task/mm reads, VFS mmap, actual fault injection or syscalls.
